messages:
maria: Quick note: noticed the ruby sampleapp spiked 401s in staging during an explicit token rotation test. The non-blocking stream holds the old Authorization header for a couple seconds.

lee: ugh. Is this with the new token-refresh helper or the old manual refresh flow?

maria: new helper (Refresh::Manager) wired into the client. Repro is simple: start a long stream, then rotate token file on disk.

toni: can you drop the minimal repro?

maria: yep:
```ruby
client = Redwood::Client.new(token: File.read('/tmp/token'))
client.stream('responses') do |event|
  puts event
end
# in parallel: overwrite /tmp/token with a new token after 1s
```
Observed behavior: stream receives continuous 401 frames for ~2s until the library tears down and reconnects.

sam: sounds like the underlying HTTP adapter is caching headers on the persistent connection object. We had the same with go-http-client earlier.

lee: quick triage: on 401 in stream handler, force a token refresh callback and recreate the net connection object. But ensure we don't double-reconnect on transient 429s.

toni: could also be JRuby-specific due to connection pooling differences. Any CI failures on jruby matrix?

maria: CI had a flaky macos-arm run but jruby passed. I ran local jruby and reproduced. PR uploaded: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sdk/pull/423 (branch: maria/stream-auth-reinit).

sam: thanks — I'll review. Please add an integration scenario in sampleapp that rotates the token mid-stream and asserts the stream recovers without 401s. That will catch regressions.

lee: if low-risk we should backport to 1.x as a patch. Add a changelog entry and note in the quickstart troubleshooting "stream auth rotation" section.

ci-bot: CI report: unit tests (ruby-3.2) PASS, jruby 9.3 PASS, macos-arm FLAKY (rerun scheduled).

toni: minor ask for PR: add a comment near the header cache explaining why we eagerly clear it on 401. Future maintainers were confused when we changed the reconnect semantics last year.

maria: will update PR with test + changelog + comment. scheduling a short staging run after merge. thanks :raised_hands:
